footprint.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; membrane area one H_ATPase copy takes (0: cytosolic)

c_syn.data_reference: akashi2002metabolic; ~P per amino acid made from glucose; Akashi & Gojobori give 12-74, 24 assumed as the proteome mean

c_poly.data_reference: definitional; textbook: 2 ~P to charge the tRNA (ATP -> AMP) and 2 GTP for elongation

c_deg.data_reference: kenniston2003linkage; ATP per amino acid for ATP-dependent proteolysis: ClpXP hydrolyses about 1 ATP per residue it translocates, plus 10 to over 500 ATP per substrate to unfold it, more for more stable proteins (Kenniston et al. 2003; single-molecule steps of 5-8 residues per power stroke, Maillard et al. 2011, put translocation nearer 0.2-0.5); 1 taken (confidence: medium, the unfolding share varies with the protein)

c_recycle.data_reference: lynch2015bioenergetic; 0.25-1 ATP per amino acid recycled (Lynch & Marinov 2015 supplement)

k_deg.data_reference: maurizi1992proteases; bulk degradation of the stable protein in growing E. coli about 1%/h (Maurizi 1992 after Pine 1970; BioNumbers BNID 109924); 0.6%/h in Willetts 1967 (growing cells); most proteins are stable and leave growing cells by dilution (Gupta et al. 2024). Rises to about 5%/h in carbon, nitrogen or phosphate starvation (Willetts 1967, non-growing cells), not modelled (confidence: high)
